app_info.subtitle: Your coaching library
app_info.description: For coaches who use Propusher. Find, create and edit exercises, workout templates, multi-week programs and questionnaires in your library, and animate exercises with a 3D figure. New items are saved straight away; edits wait as drafts until you apply them in Propusher. Clients, teams and calendars are not reachable, and nothing is deleted.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads exercises from the coach's library or Propusher's shared library; nothing is written.
justifications.open_world_justification: Talks only to Propusher's own API for the signed-in coach's account; it never reaches the open web or third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only, so nothing can be changed or lost.

test_cases.description: Search the coach's own exercises and Propusher's library.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which hamstring exercises do I have in Propusher?
test_cases.expected_output: A list of hamstring exercises from the coach's library (and, if few, from the Propusher library), each with its title and equipment.

test_cases.description: Build a workout template from existing exercises; created live.
test_cases.user_prompt: Build a 45-minute lower-body strength workout in Propusher from my exercises.
test_cases.expected_output: A new workout template with 5-7 existing exercises, sets, reps and rest, classified as strength / lower body, plus a link to open it in Propusher.

test_cases.description: Create a multi-week program on the day grid.
test_cases.user_prompt: Make a 4-week beginner running program in Propusher, three runs a week.
test_cases.expected_output: A new 4-week program with three run workouts per week on separate days and a link to it in Propusher.

test_cases.user_prompt: Write a weekly check-in questionnaire for my clients in Propusher covering sleep, stress and soreness.
test_cases.expected_output: A new questionnaire with scale questions for sleep, stress and soreness and an optional comment, plus a link to it.

test_cases.description: Edit an existing workout; the change is saved as a draft for the coach.
test_cases.user_prompt: In my Propusher workout "Upper Body A", change the bench press to 4 sets of 6.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirms the bench press entry now has 4x6, says the change is waiting as a draft to apply in Propusher, and links to the workout.

negative_test_cases.description: General fitness advice with no reference to Propusher or the coach's library should be answered by ChatGPT alone.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: How many sets per week should a beginner do for muscle growth?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Personal workout logging is a client-side action; the app only reaches the coach's library.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Log that I ran 5 km today.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Clients, teams and calendars are out of scope; no tool reaches them.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me which of my clients missed their workouts this week in Propusher.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside its supported workflows.
